source_labels.label: lem:ub-conditional-first-moment
source_labels.correspondence: Exact frozen conditional theorem, using actual retained-array margin 2 eta, initial cluster, consecutive integer windows, positive natural histories, and adapted guards. Every generic law or moment input is discharged before Main.

source_labels.label: eq:ub-exploration-alpha-budget
source_labels.correspondence: The rare threshold tau is selected with alpha strictly inside all required budgets. The proved empirical first-moment rate is delta_F = eta/8; xi = eta/10.

source_labels.label: eq:ub-exploration-exponent-budget
source_labels.correspondence: a = min(3 xi/4, 3 eta/5, eta/8), rho log k <= a/4, zeta = a/2. All scalar choices and the common threshold precede the cut array and history. The logarithmic block count and fixed-rho real power are explicitly absorbed.

source_labels.label: eq:ub-exploration-block-count
source_labels.correspondence: Actual antichains of prefix cylinders have at most 2 k K base elements. Refinement to the next good column contributes at most k^(ceil(rho log N)+1), bounded by k^2 N^(rho log k). The resulting bound is 2 k^3 T log N N^(rho log k). Late short suffixes are proved tiny from the terminal maximal-word margin.

source_labels.label: eq:ub-one-history-jensen
source_labels.correspondence: Finite conditional Jensen and exact tower identities hold for the actual auxiliary future-family view, with arbitrary information codomain reduced to its finite image. Fixed rank slots assign each edge to at most one block, avoiding an extra block-count factor. Current-run extras include the crossing edge.

source_labels.label: eq:ub-actual-conditional-remaining
source_labels.correspondence: Separate positive natural-history fibers factor under the actual independent pair law. The cross-history term is bounded by half the sum of both self-intersections. Time zero uses the actual whole-deck first moment; terminal time uses the identically zero literal remainder.

discharged_inputs.details: Actual induced suffix Cuts, population at least two, original log N, retained g/2 first goodness and margin eta are proved before applying F. Time zero weakens actual 2 eta margin to eta.

discharged_inputs.input: Concentration probability and adapted conditional failure
discharged_inputs.details: The actual H probability estimate is proved as a C conclusion. Bad H samples contribute explicit N epsilon costs, averaged under the original history. Histories are never conditioned on H, R or S1.

discharged_inputs.input: Actual forward and backward count, collision and current-copy estimates
discharged_inputs.provider: RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir and RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.Backward: prefixCount, tailCollisions, extraCurrentCopies
discharged_inputs.details: Arbitrary nonroot prefixes are adapted to actual tail bins. Terminal beta is supplied by original margin. The no-current-direction branch has zero literal remainder, so no hasDirection premise survives.

The family is structurally prefix separated, lies strictly in the same-pile future, and has actual fixed absolute ranks and induced chronological columns. Auxiliary labeled row sets and counts are erased by the proved tower.

discharged_inputs.input: Generic cardinality and small-error hypotheses in helper lemmas
discharged_inputs.provider: Actual cylinder construction and concentration bound
discharged_inputs.details: The actual M is B.card. Refinement-count hypotheses, scalar positivity, rho budget and exceptional-probability decay are all discharged; no helper certificate appears in C.

discharged_inputs.input: Separate-event pair conditioning and finite averaging
discharged_inputs.provider: Shared.PairConditioning and Shared.FiniteLawAdapters, with lower Compat.Conditioning
discharged_inputs.details: Uniform independent fixed-count samples, positive product factors and literal equality fibers instantiate the generic finite lemmas. Null auxiliary fibers use the defined zero convention.

proof_cover_enlargement.description: The proof covers all strict future words in the same initial pile, including words past the directional middle cutoff. The literal directional remaining-edge event is retained as a subset.
proof_cover_enlargement.justification: The accepted reservoir and graph laws require same-pile support, strict future and a nonroot structurally separated prefix family. The enlarged family satisfies these properties and retains the exact 2 k K base count.

boundary_checks: N0 >= 2 is fixed uniformly before all arrays; zero and one ambient populations are outside the asymptotic premise.
Zero-mass and zero/one-row cylinders are allowed in the tiny branch; the large branch proves its induced population is at least two.
Impossible histories are excluded exactly by the existing positive-history premise; null auxiliary fibers keep the literal conditional convention.
Backward exploration reverses spatial order only; induced tail columns retain their chronological order.
Current-run right-endpoint injection includes the crossing edge at i-1.
At mu = N^-xi the tiny bound applies; mu = N^xi is covered by the intermediate bound.
Both independent observed histories remain in the cross-history arithmetic bound.
Time zero and terminal time have separate actual proofs.
